title: Habits tell you
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: What would a stranger learn about your habits from your car?
I said: in our own company we have been through a lot of people. What were some of the mistakes we made in the filtering? A student said: low accountability. Letting people do what they wanted.

You meet somebody and the resume looks incredible, I said, but there is almost no way to check accountability on a resume. You can go to results, but you don't know the details of what they did. What question would you ask?

A student said: ask what other people say about them. References from past jobs, or professors for a student who just graduated. Another said: give them a test that makes it easy for someone else to be blamed, and see how they treat it.

A student said: how do they present themselves? I said: one of the things I look at is their physical surroundings. Are they orderly and clean? How do they treat their environment? Is their car clean?

You are not going to give a million dollars to a person when you get into their car and there are four empty coffee cups on the floor from two weeks ago and it smells bad, I said. How structured is their thinking? What habits do they have? The habits will tell you how accountable somebody is.

I said the person in the book runs a factory where you can eat from the floor. This is an accountability pattern that starts with habits. These are signs, and they apply to hiring and to doing business with somebody.
If you don't have an effective way to build a team, I said, forget about being an entrepreneur. You simply won't make it.
What would your own surroundings say about you?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the mistakes you have made in hiring.
Write one question that would show a person's sense of responsibility.
Write whom you would ask for a reference.
Write what you would look at in a person's surroundings, honestly.
Write what your own habits say about you.

check.q: What did a student say was the main mistake in screening?
What did I say you can't check on a resume?
What did I say habits tell you?

recap: Screen for accountability. Habits and surroundings are signs. Check your own first.
